notes.title: Playtesters Wanted!
notes.content:
We're about two months away from releasing our game on Steam and we are super excited about it!

We just need some more people to volunteer and playtest our game so we can get it really polished. 

The way we've been doing it is:

1.  You email us at: [h1]info@markafterdark.ca[/h1]
2.  We provide you with a Dropbox link with the game file
3.  And a Google Sheets link with our playtest notes template.

So. Got a couple hours to kill?? Please help us! :)

We're looking for:

-  Typos
-  Game-breaking bugs
-  Glitches
-  General feedback on content

As a reward, we will give you a free game code when the game is released on Steam. <3

Thanks in advance!!  xoxo
